text:
ITEM 1 | Bright red strawberries, a mix of whole and halved, with glossy skin, white-green stem remnants, and a juicy, moist look; clustered at lower-left center of the bowl, roughly 6 cm wide in total, about 3 cm tall | 120 g
ITEM 2 | Small dark navy-blue berries, smooth and glossy, about 1–1.5 cm each, about 20 berries in a loose cluster between the strawberries and the cubes; firm, round, holding shape | 45 g
ITEM 3 | Pinkish-red fruit flesh cut into wedges and rectangular chunks about 3–4 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, with small pale seeds visible, moist and juicy surface, lower-right of bowl | 110 g
ITEM 4 | Cubed pieces about 2.5 cm each, golden to medium-brown, with darker crisp browned edges and a matte, slightly dry, uneven surface; firm, holds its shape, piled in a heap in the upper-right of the bowl, about 4 cm tall | 130 g
ITEM 5 | Thin smear and small puddle of clear-to-pink liquid, glossy, a few mm thick, lying beside the fruit wedges at the lower-right edge of the bowl | 5 g
ITEM 6 | Pale off-white crumbly soft pieces with a few red streaks, sitting on a separate plate to the left, irregular chunks about 1–2 cm, matte and moist-looking | 20 g
